title: andryala pinnatifida subsp. cuneifolia
intro: Andryala pinnatifida subsp. cuneifolia, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Andryala, is a plant species belonging to the aster family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents of Andryala pinnatifida subsp. cuneifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
